build_SharedMLP: build a SharedMLP module with a list of channel sizes for 2D conv layers
create_Conv2d: create a Conv2d layer with optional batch normalization and ReLU activation
create_Conv1d: create a Conv1d layer with optional batch normalization and kaiming weight init
create_BNMomentumScheduler: create a BNMomentumScheduler to adjust batch norm momentum per training epoch
review_FC: review the FC class that builds a linear layer with optional batch norm and activation
